title: Coefficient square for the open projection factor
statement: Fix a finite-field datum \(D\), its coefficient datum \(C\), a finite extension \(E/\mathbb Q_\ell\), \(n\ge1\), and a normalized six-functor operation datum \(S\) at \((E,n)\) [def-fix-six-functor-datum]. Assume \(\ell\) is invertible in \(D.k\). Let \(o\) be simultaneous-system operations and \(z\) their specified realization data. Let \(f:X\to Y\) be a separated, locally finite-type, quasi-compact morphism of six-functor spaces, and fix a compactification \(c=(j:X\to\bar X,p:\bar X\to Y)\). Let \(K\) and \(L\) be bounded constructible derived-complete integral objects on \(X\) and \(Y\), with \(L\) of uniform finite-reduction Tor amplitude. Put \(A=S.\mathrm{higher}.\mathrm{integralExchange}(\mathrm{identitySquare}(f,c))\). Use sourceMap and targetMap of [def-sf-integral-projection-coordinate-data], first and second of [def-sf-integral-projection-factor-data], and middleMap, systemFirst and systemSecond of [def-sf-integral-projection-middle-map]. Write \(\alpha\gg\beta\) for first \(\alpha\), then \(\beta\). Then \(\mathrm{middleMap}(K,L)\gg\mathrm{systemSecond}(\mathrm{red}(K),\mathrm{red}(L))=\mathrm{red}(\mathrm{second}(A,K,L))\gg\mathrm{targetMap}(K,L)\). Both sides start at reduction of \(A.\mathrm{properPush}(T_{\bar X}(A.\mathrm{openExtension}(K),A.\mathrm{properPull}(L)))\). This is the coefficient square for the open projection and inverse pullback compositor alone; no proper projection occurs.

source.place: Compactification-independence sentence: compatibility of individual refinement maps with counits and j_!, before the projection square is deduced. Integral-system realization steps 1 and 3 of lem-sf-integral-projection-refinement-square.

proof.text: The pullReduction formula is natural: paste naturality of the actual completed-pullback model and the reconstruction counit. Transport through the datum properPull and integralPullback functor equalities. Inverting that naturality square and applying the proper adjunction Hom bijection to counit naturality proves directReduction_naturality.

Let W be the datum tensor/pullback input, q the integral open projection followed by its input equality transport, and r inverse support identification followed by its support equality transport. Naturality of inverse compactSupportIdentification gives second = properPush.map(q) followed by r, including the equality transports.

Apply the open tensor/compositor coefficient square before proper image, and apply the one-input support factorization to W. Expand middleMap and systemSecond; functoriality applies proper system image to the local square. Use directReduction_naturality for q, then the support factorization for W. Functoriality of reduction and second_factorization combine red(properPush.map q) and red(r) into red(second). The remaining supportReduction followed by support of inverse inputReduction is targetMap by definition.

proof_origin.place: Compatibility with counits and j_! sentence: naturality of the proper mate, local open tensor/compositor square before proper image, and one-input support factorization; U9.

lean.statement:
theorem integralProjectionOpenFactorReduction
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (C : D.CoefficientDatum)
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic C.l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic C.l) E] (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (S : SixFunctorOperationDatum D C E n hn) (hl : IsUnit (C.l : D.k))
    (o : Operations C.l E) (z : Realizations C.l E D o)
    {X Y : SixFunctorSpace D} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsSeparated f.hom.left] [LocallyOfFiniteType f.hom.left] [QuasiCompact f.hom.left]
    (c : Compactification f.hom.left)
    (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory C.l E X.obj.left)
    (L : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory C.l E Y.obj.left)
    (hL : finiteTorConstructibleIntegral C.l E Y.obj.left L.obj) :
    ProjectionFactors.middleMap D C E n hn S hl o z f c K L ≫
        ProjectionFactors.systemSecond D C E o z f c
          ((calculus C.l E X.obj.left).reduction.obj K.obj)
          ((calculus C.l E Y.obj.left).reduction.obj L.obj) =
      (calculus C.l E Y.obj.left).reduction.map
        (ProjectionFactors.second (S.higher.integralExchange (identitySquare f c)) K L).hom ≫
          Coordinates.targetMap D C E S.higher hl o z f c K L
